sources.snippet: Qwen AgentWorld 35B A3B is an open-weight multimodal model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion active parameters per token, designed for agent-based applications with extended context. The model uses a hybrid sparse mixture-of-experts architecture with Gated DeltaNet linear attention and supports text, image, and video inputs.
